p1_smoke.finding: Negative result. In all 8 trials the fewest isosceles triples at cardinality 59 was 2, and it was the state immediately after forcing one point into the source 58 (swap 0). 200000 swaps and 9 restarts per trial never reached 1 or 0. The smoke shows the infrastructure works; it gives no evidence that this operator makes progress toward 59.

p1_iteration_2.finding: Negative result. None of the 80 destroy-four attempts reached depth 5, and all 80 ended by enumerating their whole search space far below the 20000-node cap. After removing four points only 4 or 5 cells had zero add cost: the four removed points and at most one other. The destroy-four neighbourhood of these 58-point sets is therefore almost rigid, and the node cap was never the limit. The swap fallback again stayed at 2 violations from swap 0. Under the plan's classification this is 'no progress'.

p1_iteration_3.finding: Negative result. None of the 80 destroy-eight attempts reached depth 9, and all 80 enumerated their whole search space far below the 200000-node cap. After removing eight points only 8 to 10 cells had zero add cost: the eight removed points and at most two others. The swap fallback again stayed at 2 violations from swap 0. The search hypothesis of iteration 3 is rejected.

blockers: The P1 destroy/repair operator family is closed as stopped with no 59 found; there is no candidate algorithm to freeze, so the confirmatory run has nothing to confirm.

The immutable P1 run artifacts cite their execution-time base HEAD 2914794 with dirty=true plus file hashes; the exact implementation, rejected variants and artifacts are now preserved together in evidence commit 3402f10.

The P0 solver parameters and 1000000-iteration budget were calibrated on off-gate seeds 1000..1015 and those runs were not saved.
The public method's source and budget are not pinned; the public point list comes from a mutable GitHub issue and only its retrieved hash is pinned.
The older swarm path is unchanged: it still seeds from the public certificate, hardcodes TRI-18, and uses same-algorithm sandbox verification.
Local interpreter is Python 3.12.13 while pyproject targets 3.11.
P2 Modal cost is unknown: no authoritative per-Sandbox cost is exposed to this client.
P2 showed no Modal speedup: startup overhead dominates the ~1 s solve at 100000 iterations.
P2 isolation evidence is requested configuration plus an in-Sandbox self-report; there is no provider-side attestation.
Exa and past.dev remain untested and were not called. No Linear or Slack update was posted (external writes were not authorized).

p2_result.speedup_claim: none: Modal was slower than both local parallel and local serial-equivalent at this budget
p2_result.isolation: all four Sandboxes: runtime vm requested and accepted, block_network true, 1 CPU, 512 MiB, 120 s lifetime, no secrets, no mounts; in-Sandbox probe reported network blocked and no credential-like env names; source read-back hash matched; each terminated in finally (exit 137); zero live Sandboxes in the app afterwards
p2_result.cost_status: unknown: the provider exposes no authoritative per-sandbox cost to this client
limits_of_the_evidence: One run of four seeds: no variance estimate, and no claim about scale beyond four Sandboxes.

The isolation probe runs inside the untrusted Sandbox and is self-reported: three outbound attempts (two TCP connects, one DNS lookup) failed. VM runtime rests on Modal accepting runtime='vm' and a non-gVisor kernel string; there is no provider-side attestation in the artifacts.

No-secrets rests on the gateway having no code path that attaches a Secret, Volume, mount or env, plus a names-only env screen. GPG_KEY (the public release-signing fingerprint name set by the upstream python base image) is allowlisted by exact name; its value was never read.
local_serial_equivalent_seconds is the sum of per-trial wall times under the parallel local run, not a separate serial run. In-Sandbox CPU time is not observable and is null.
sandbox_prepare_seconds (1.62 s) reflects an image cached by the disclosed preflight; the preflight's cold prepare took 11.13 s.
The Sandbox 'solve' phase (2.47 s mean) includes the exec round trip, so it is not a pure CPU comparison with the 1.04 s local trials.
